extras.agent_focus: New and up-and-coming competitors to Hugging Face and ModelScope, judged on the hard test the brief sets: a credible HF competitor must permit multi-TB objects and generous per-account storage, because model weights and datasets routinely run to hundreds of GB / TiB. Split into three classes — Chinese domestic hubs (HF is blocked there, so a separate ecosystem exists), Western MLOps artifact stores (W&B/Comet/ClearML/Lightning/Deep Lake), and dataset-publishing startups (Source Cooperative, Oxen, OpenDataLab). Excluded and not re-reported: Hugging Face, ModelScope, Kaggle, Civitai, Ollama, Replicate, DagsHub, OpenML, fal.ai, Baseten, Modal.

binding_note: the per-object cap sets the shard size and therefore the object count; it bounds the total more tightly than any headline quota
